paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Natan.
In [Pesachim 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.115a.3) he told Ravina: “This is what Hillel, the Amora, said on the authority of received tradition.”[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Gemara, Ravina quotes Rav Mesharshiya, who reports Hillel’s teaching from received tradition. Hyman identifies this Hillel as an Amora.
